propositions: A new advisory criterion 'asserted-capability' must be registered in the G6/E4 rubric family to detect when a plan asserts a named module provides or lacks a capability that contradicts the actual code.
The criterion must fire on both directions: (A) plan asserts module M provides capability C but M lacks it, and (B) plan asserts capability C is absent but M already provides it.
The probe must be implemented as a code-grounded agentic finder plugging into the existing four-pass machinery (finder, verifier, decide, coach) with advisory posture and never block.

Registration seam requirements must be satisfied: entry in CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, AGENT_TIER collections; routing in criteria_routing.json; rubric prompt and guide section; validate_packaged_routing() and validate_criteria_guide() must pass.

Deterministic unit tests and a bounded sanity check fixture set (3 E1-verified misses: dc58, db7b, 5886 as must-fire; 3 clean plans as must-not-fire) must demonstrate recall >=0.66 and advisory false-positives as dogfood signal for future promotion gate.

The criterion must auto-flow into the standing effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py) with zero per-criterion wiring and be cited as subject to advisory→blocking promotion via the gate documented in plan-review-gate.md.
